property_summary: After any number of newGrantProposal calls, the proposalCount must equal the total number of successful calls; the bug increments proposalCount twice per call, so it exceeds the call count.
After any sequence of calls to newGrantProposal, the value of proposalCount equals the number of such calls.
After any call to newGrantProposal, the reference proposalCount is strictly greater than before the call, while the buggy version leaves it unchanged.
After a successful init call, a subsequent address-type proposal that targets 'UTILS' can be finalized via completeProposal without reverting only if VADER has been set to a non-zero address.
After init, any call that interacts with VADER through moveUtils (i.e. finalizing a UTILS proposal) must revert unless VADER was set to a non-zero address.
After a successful init call, the VADER variable must be set to the address passed as the first argument.
